findings.details: Three of four claims cross agenda boundaries or misattribute owners/speakers. Essential action coverage is missing. Whole-summary self-review rejection was appropriate, but one unsupported claim was marked supported.
Three of four citation bundles are incomplete and release, roadmap and onboarding actions are omitted. The same-model all-supported/sufficient verdict is a false acceptance.

English output despite Korean query; omits drafting ownership and approved-charter registration although required evidence is present in actual cited chunks. Related amendment rules do not replace the requested formation procedure.
Returns a supported generic membership rule instead of abstaining from the unavailable confirmed scope/roster. No roster was fabricated, but the response fails the original answerability criterion.

metadata_and_items.limitations: Literal projection avoids invented metadata but misses dates/attendance outside its grammar. Action/proposal classification and owner extraction still lose agenda context. No fresh browser inspection.

next_hypothesis: QA-only profile-local request contract: explicit target language, every requested fact and full abstention when established outcomes are unavailable. Same model/schema/caps/public questions and source order; no OPEN-specific answer hints or summary reruns.
